en: Black‑and‑white photograph of a massive baroque stone city gate with rusticated masonry and a large central archway closed by an ornate wrought‑iron grille above. On both sides of the central passage are smaller pedestrian doors. Over each side door is an elaborate sculpted coat of arms with a crown and Latin inscription tablet beneath. Through the archway a cobbled street and old buildings are visible. A small plaque with the number 167 is fixed to the right pier, and the lower right corner of the image bears the number 56.5.
